description: The baseline adds a chargeback tag, COST_CENTER, to every workspace's policy and warehouse.
config_diff:
--- a/config/defaults/cost.yaml
+++ b/config/defaults/cost.yaml
 tags:
   BUSINESS_UNIT: "{PREFIX}"
   APPID: NONE
   COST_CATEGORY: CITIZEN_SELF_SERVICE
+  COST_CENTER: UNASSIGNED              # finance asked for it on every workspace
workspace_file:
prefix: ss1
host: https://adb-1234567890123456.7.azuredatabricks.net
groups:
  users: ss1-cd-users
  explorer: ss1-cd-explorers
  builder: ss1-cd-builders
  publisher: null
catalog:
  storage_root: abfss://catalogs@examplestorage.dfs.core.windows.net/self_service_1
sql_warehouse:
  size: X-Small
preflight:
ok: signed in as the pipeline, a workspace admin
ok: metastore sandbox_canadacentral
ok: account group ss1-cd-users (users)
ok: account group ss1-cd-explorers (explorer)
ok: account group ss1-cd-builders (builder)
ok: no publisher group: skipped (nobody gets it in this workspace)
ok: account group ss1_platform_admins (platform_admins)
ok: nothing found that still uses legacy access (Hive metastore, DBFS mounts, legacy clusters)
